drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. For discussion, we propose a Settlement Amount of $100,000, payable within 30 calendar days after the agreement is signed by both parties. We have narrowed the release to claims arising from the dispute through the signing date and added customary confidentiality exceptions. Please let us know your client's views.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff $100,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 calendar days after this Agreement is signed by both parties, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.
edits.name: Partner review: amount requires client approval before sending

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims Plaintiff has or may have against Defendant arising out of the matters resolved by this Agreement, to the extent based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is signed by both parties. This release does not affect either party’s right to enforce this Agreement.
edits.name: Clarify release scope

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal, tax, or financial advisers who are informed of their confidential nature; as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; or as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental authority. A party making a required disclosure shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party prompt notice.
edits.name: Customary confidentiality exceptions
